entities.summary: Kirill Igorevich Marchenko is a Russian professional ice hockey player who is a winger for the Columbus Blue Jackets of the National Hockey League (NHL). Marchenko was selected by the Blue Jackets with the 49th overall pick in the 2018 NHL entry draft.
